content.passage: Last weekend, Mai and her friends went to the Mid-Autumn Festival. They saw lanterns and ate mooncakes. Now they have a plan for the summer. "Let's go to Phu Quoc island!" Tom says. "That is a great idea," Anna says. Nam is worried: "I do not have money." "Maybe we can work at Mrs. Rosa's café," Mai says. "Then we will have money soon." Nam smiles. "I hope Mrs. Rosa will say yes!" Mai thinks about the future. Her dream is to visit Tom's family in Canada one day.

guideText:
Mẫu câu chính: "What will you do this weekend?" (Cuối tuần này bạn sẽ làm gì?) — "I went to the museum." (Tôi đã đi bảo tàng.) — "That is a good idea!" (Ý hay đấy!)
Tương lai: will + động từ nguyên mẫu: "I will call you." Rút gọn: I'll, you'll, we'll. Phủ định: will not = won't.
Quá khứ bất quy tắc phải học thuộc: go → went, see → saw, eat → ate, buy → bought, forget → forgot.
"Maybe" (có lẽ) đứng đầu câu: "Maybe it will rain tomorrow."
Rủ rê: "Let's ..." (Chúng ta hãy ... nhé): "Let's have a picnic."
